02/12.11.2024

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Panki P.S. Case No. 80 of 2023,
corresponding to POCSO Case No. 43 of 2024, for the offences registered under Section 376 of the I.P.C. and Sections 4 & 8 of the POCSO Act, but charge has been framed under Section 376DA of the IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-IV-cum-Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau at Daltonganj.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-IV-cum-Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO Act, Palamau at Daltonganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: On 03.07.2023 at about 12:30 noon, the informant was going to a tailoring shop, when the accused persons intercepted her.
She was taken to the house of Bhubaneshwar Yadav, where the petitioner is said to have raped her.
While disposing of the bail application of co-accused persons this Court had the opportunity to peruse the case diary.

It appears that several witnesses have stated that the victim was having affairs with the petitioner and they were caught red handed in the house of the Bhubaneshwar Yadav,
thereafter, this case has been registered.
It further appears that other co- accused persons have been granted bail by this Court earlier.
In view of the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
